meta.title: DoA Threshold Currency (approval.doa.currency) = EUR
gaps: Change the tenant setting approval.doa.currency from INR to EUR.
Use Modular Approval Setup to attach approvals to entities such as events, onboarding, purchase orders, payments, and letters of credit.
Observe and verify that Delegation of Authority spend threshold definitions use EUR and differ from the default INR.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Change the tenant setting approval.doa.currency from INR to EUR.; Use Modular Approval Setup to attach approvals to entities such as events, onboarding, purchase orders, payments, and letters of credit.; Observe and verify that Delegation of Authority spend threshold definitions use EUR and differ from the default INR.

args.need: as the Tenant Admin, set approval.doa.currency to EUR, use Modular Approval Setup to open the Delegation of Authority matrix, and verify that all spend threshold definitions display EUR instead of INR

steps.note: No catalog step can modify this tenant setting or observe the Modular Approval Setup and DoA threshold currency behavior.
Verify the session remains free of crashes or server errors after the tester performs the unavailable workflow.
